consent.intro: Before you continue, please read and accept the terms of use.
consent.b1: The app is a media player. It does not host, broadcast or sell any channels, movies or streams. No content is included when you install it.
consent.b2: The playlists (M3U) and links you add come from you. You confirm that you hold the necessary rights or permissions for the content they lead to, in accordance with the laws of your country.
consent.t3: Every link is checked before playback
consent.b3: For a worry-free experience, every link you add is checked (format and availability) before it is offered for playback. An invalid link is clearly flagged — never an endless wait.
consent.t4: Instant playback, never a spinning wheel
consent.b4: Available movies preload on your device so they start immediately. If something can't be played, the app tells you right away instead of keeping you waiting.
consent.refused: TV King cannot be used without accepting the terms.

download.title: Download
download.intro: Always the latest version. No content is provided with the app: it plays the sources from your subscription.
download.tvKicker: Android TV box · Fire TV · Google TV
download.tvBody: The complete app: live TV, movies, series, recordings. Activated by your reseller.
download.tvStep1: On the box, install the “Downloader” app.
download.tvStep3: Install and open Zuno, then give the MAC address shown to your reseller.
download.tvNote: Updates are then handled from within the app (Settings → Update).
download.pcBody: The same app as on your TV, in full screen. Keyboard: arrow keys, Enter, Esc, F11.
download.pcStep2: If Windows shows “Unknown publisher”: More info → Run anyway.
download.pcStep3: Open Zuno, then give the MAC address shown to your reseller.
download.playBody: Play Store release coming soon. In the meantime, use the APK for the box.

mv1.title: Crown of Steel
mv1.description: A kingdom on the brink of collapse, and an heir no one ever expected to take the throne. A sweeping epic of rare power.

mv2.title: The Last Sprint
mv2.description: At 34, a fallen sprinter gives himself one last season to become a champion again — and to make peace with his son.

mv3.title: Sleepless in Dakar
mv3.description: Over a single night, a journalist follows the trail of a disappearance, from the rooftops of the Medina to the port of Dakar.

mv4.title: The King's Laugh
mv4.description: A struggling comedian is mistakenly appointed official jester to a royal court that takes etiquette very seriously.

mv5.title: Frequency 88.0
mv5.description: A pirate radio station picks up a signal from thirty years in the future. Every broadcast changes the present.

mv6.title: Dad, Coach & Champion
mv6.description: Drafted in to coach his daughter's under-10 team, a former pro discovers that the hardest part is snack time.

mv7.title: Her Majesty's Holiday
mv7.description: A queen goes incognito at a family campsite: protocol, barbecues and mix-ups guaranteed.

mv8.title: My Robot and Me
mv8.description: A shy child inherits an old-fashioned companion robot — one that's far braver than it looks.

mv9.title: The Great Journey
mv9.description: Two cousins cycle across the country to deliver a letter that should never have gone astray.

activate.title: Activate my list
activate.intro: Add your own subscription (Xtream or M3U) to your Zuno box. It appears in the app automatically, with nothing to type on the remote.
activate.macHint: Shown in Zuno → Settings → My device (e.g. MK:80:78:60:07:4F).
activate.success: All set! Open Zuno: your list will appear in under a minute (or press Restart).
activate.privacy: Your password is sent to your box only once and is never displayed again.

errors.mac: Invalid MAC address. Copy it again from Zuno → Settings → My device.
errors.notEntitled: This box hasn't been activated yet. Ask your reseller to activate it, then try again.
errors.fields: Please fill in all fields. Addresses must start with http:// or https://.
errors.tooMany: List limit reached: delete one to add another.
errors.network: Server unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't save the list. Please try again in a moment.
